description: Configuration keywords for 3DEC plot item types created via 'plot item create <type>'. Item types and keyword sets are binary-validated against 3DEC 9.0.

items.name: block
items.description: Whole-block visualization — draws blocks (and their outer zone faces) with field contouring and categorical labelling.

items.name: bzone
items.description: Deformable-block continuum zones — the FLAC-style zone field view inside 3DEC blocks.

items.name: blockcontact
items.description: Block-block contacts (the contact between two blocks, parent of subcontacts).

items.name: subcontact
items.description: Sub-contacts — the discretized contact segments where the joint constitutive model acts.

items.name: joint
items.description: Joint-plane visualization across the model — draw joint surfaces, restrict to 'cracked' (failed) segments, 'contour' by a named joint property or value, project orientations on a 'stereonet', and 'label' categorically.

items.name: structure
items.description: Structural-element (SEL) visualization, one item type per element: structure-beam / structure-cable / structure-pile (line elements, carry the 'line' keyword) and structure-geogrid / structure-liner / structure-shell (surface elements, carry 'polygons').
items.common_use: structure-beam, structure-cable, structure-pile, structure-geogrid, structure-liner, structure-shell, structure-vector

items.name: fracture
items.description: Discrete Fracture Network (DFN) fractures — draw fracture polygons/shapes, colour by numeric/tensor/text/vector property via 'color-by', show 'intersections' and 'ghosts', and analyse orientation with 'stereonet' / 'rosette'.

items.name: flow
items.description: Fracture-flow network items: 'flowplane' (the planar flow domain on joints — contour/label, cracked), 'fknot' (flow knots/nodes — contour pore pressure/head), and 'fblock' (flow blocks).

items.name: chart-history
items.description: History time-series line chart: bind traces with 'history <name>', plot vs step or cross-plot vs another history. Complements references/histories-and-results (sampling workflow).
items.common_use: Plot recorded histories over cycling: convergence ratio, block/joint force-slip, energy

notes: Plot-item keywords are appended after the item type.
Some compound settings are easier to apply with 'plot item modify <id> ...' after creating the item.

Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Keyword sets here were re-verified against live 3DEC 9.7.47 (previously binary-validated against 3DEC 9.0 only).

Live 3DEC 9.7.47 enumerates exactly 48 item types (see live_item_type_enumeration_97) - the registry is ENGINE-SCOPED: no PFC/FLAC-only types (ball, clump, zone, ...) appear, unlike FLAC3D 9.7 whose unified enumeration lists ~95 types from all engines.
Aliases verified live: 'jvector' = 'jointvector' (identical keyword sets); 'fplane' twins 'flowplane'; 'wall' and 'blockface' share the 'block' keyword set.

Additional live types beyond the documented core, with first-slot keyword sets captured in the verification workspace: block-vector, block-eigen, block-isosurface, block-zone-profile, bgroup, boundary (fluid/mechanical/thermal), fos, thrust, traction, water, particle-trace, stereonet, zonetensor, geometry, structure-dowel (own 21-keyword set), structure-hybrid (= beam family), plus chart/data/axes/scalebox/history-locations/struct-node-fix infrastructure items.

plot command family re-stamped on 3DEC 9.7: 'plot ?' enumerates 22 subcommands (active background clear copy create current delete export item legend load movie outline print-size rename reset show target title title-job update view); 'plot export' formats: bitmap csv datafile dxf pdf postscript print svg; 'plot export bitmap' takes dpi/dpm/filename/size; 'plot view' takes center clip-back clip-front dip dip-direction distance eye isometric magnification projection reset roll rotation (3D navigation only - no 2D 'extent' keyword; 3DEC is 3D-only). Name-first delete form 'plot <name> delete' verified working.
